blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Coach LA Tenorio commended the defensive effort Magnolia put up in routing Barangay Ginebra anew in the second “Manila Clasico” of the PBA Governors’ Cup. The Hotshots blew out the Gin Kings, 112-93, on Sunday at Smart Araneta Coliseum to become the first team from Group B to qualify for the quarterfinals, and Tenorio was glad they responded in a big way. “We really focused on defending the execution of Ginebra,” said Tenorio. “When we play against Ginebra, we really have to pay attention to their execution.
